summary: AgriSmart AI is a web-based decision-support platform designed to transform NASA Earth observations, local soil characteristics, and agronomic thresholds into actionable crop rotation and field resilience strategies.The platform addresses the challenge—shifting temperatures, water deficits, extreme weather, and declining soil health—by moving farmers away from monoculture vulnerabilities toward climate-adapted multi-season planning. Integrating NASA Earth observations (SMAP root-zone soil moisture, ECOSTRESS thermal stress/evapotranspiration, GPM precipitation, and MODIS vegetation dynamics), AgriSmart AI evaluates microclimates against crop physiological demands (e.g., wheat, legumes, corn, cotton). It generates optimal irrigation regimes ($L/m^2$), prescribes targeted soil amendments to rebuild organic matter, and simulates climate anomalies (frost at 1°C, heatwaves at 39°C, high winds) to stress-test rotation feasibility before planting. An integrated dual-tier advisory AI (built-in expert logic paired with Google Gemini) clarifies trade-offs, while an audit logbook tracks field practices and quantifies water conserved over time
details:
Project Overview: AgriSmart AI

AgriSmart AI is a precision agriculture decision-support platform designed to transform raw environmental and geographical data into actionable agronomic guidance. It bridges the gap between complex climate analytics and daily farm management, empowering smallholders and commercial farmers to optimize resource allocation, safeguard crop health, and maintain accountability.

1. What It Does & How It Works

The platform operates across three interconnected modules:

  1. Intelligent Diagnostics & Prescriptions (Core Engine):
    • Location & Crop Input: The farmer sets geographic coordinates and selects their crop (e.g., Wheat, Corn, Cotton, Tomatoes, Rice).
    • Microclimate Analysis: The engine evaluates live environmental parameters—via Google Weather API integration or contextual simulation modes (Heatwave, Storm, Frost, High Wind)—to assess temperature, precipitation, and humidity viability against specific crop thresholds.
    • Agronomic Calculations: If suitable, the system generates precise irrigation requirements ($L/m^2$ or $m^3/ha$) and chemical recommendations (fertilizers, pesticides, soil conditioners) tailored to current stress conditions.
    • Supply Chain Matching: Suggests nearby verified agricultural suppliers and chemical dispensaries based on spatial proximity.
    • Dual AI Architecture: Features a built-in offline expert agronomy rule engine for instant guidance, alongside an optional Google Gemini Flash API integration (via custom API key) for deep, multi-turn reasoning and visual diagnostic inquiries.
    • Farmers log daily operations—such as irrigation volumes applied, fertilizer types, and spray timings.
    • The platform evaluates whether the logged procedure conforms to optimal agronomic standards under current weather parameters.
    • Displays a chronological history of logged decisions in an auditable ledger (Entered Procedure, Status, Correct Procedure, and Conserved Water).
    • Computes a dynamic cumulative metric: Total Conserved Water ($L/m^2$), quantifying sustainability and water savings over time.

2. Benefits to the Farmer

  • Water & Input Optimization: Eliminates guesswork by prescribing exact irrigation volumes based on evapotranspiration and rainfall, preventing over-watering and nutrient leaching.
  • Cost Reduction: Reduces expenditure on agrochemicals by timing applications to weather windows (e.g., avoiding chemical runoff during high winds or imminent rain).
  • Crop Loss Prevention: Climate simulation alerts (frost, extreme heat, storm surges) provide preemptive mitigation procedures before conditions turn catastrophic.
  • Accountability & Learning: By comparing actual farmer practices against calibrated benchmarks, the system trains farmers on best practices while quantifying exact water saved.

3. Intended Impact

  • Combating Water Scarcity: Direct alignment with UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 6: Clean Water, SDG 12: Responsible Consumption, SDG 13: Climate Action) by conserving freshwater in arid and drought-prone regions.
  • Democratizing Precision Farming: Delivers advanced enterprise-grade agronomy and AI diagnostics directly to smallholder farmers through accessible web tech, without requiring expensive physical sensor rigs.
  • Soil & Ecosystem Preservation: Discourages overuse of nitrogen and phosphate fertilizers, mitigating groundwater contamination and soil salinity build-up.

4. Technical Stack (Tools, Languages, & Architecture)

  • Front-End Architecture: Modern web stack (HTML5, Responsive CSS3 / Tailwind layout, JavaScript / React UI components) engineered for low-latency browser rendering.
    • NASA POWER Agroclimatology API (power.larc.nasa.gov):
      • Queries All-Sky Surface Downwelling Solar Radiation (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN in MJ/m2/d\text{MJ/m}^2/\text{d}MJ/m2/d) derived from NASA CERES satellite sensors and GEOS-5 FP-IT reanalysis.
      • Queries Surface Soil Wetness (GWETTOP, 0–5 cm0\text{--}5\text{ cm}0–5 cm) and Root-Zone Soil Wetness (GWETROOT, 0–100 cm0\text{--}100\text{ cm}0–100 cm) from the NASA MERRA-2 Catchment Land Surface Model.
      • Solves the FAO-56 Penman-Monteith net radiation energy balance (RnR_nRn​) to determine exact crop water requirements (ETcET_cETc​) and avoid guesswork.
      • NASA MODIS Terra TrueColor Satellite Layer: Daily optical satellite imagery with dynamic date fallback.
      • NASA MODIS Terra NDVI 8-Day Composite: Live normalized vegetation index mapping canopy photosynthetic health.
      • NASA Suomi NPP VIIRS Earth at Night (Black Marble): Nighttime lights.
      • NASA Blue Marble Shaded Relief: Topographic bathymetry basemap.
      • Switchable alongside 0.3m high-resolution field zoom (Esri) and OpenStreetMap.
      • Real-time global tracking of active wildfires 🔥, severe storms/hurricanes 🌀, floods 🌊, and volcanoes 🌋.
      • Live distance calculation to the user's farm pin: triggers immediate hazard alerts if an event is detected within 250 km.
      • Interactive hazard markers plotted directly on the Leaflet map and displayed in an on-screen monitor.
      • Official vector NASA Meatball insignia, open science tags, and data provenance disclosures with direct links to NASA Worldview and the NASA POWER Data Viewer.
  • Data Persistence & State Management: Browser LocalStorage / Client session state paired with REST backend integration to store farmer authentication profiles and historical audit logs.
  • Deployment & Hosting: Continuous integration and global edge deployment via Vercel.

5. Creative & Novel Highlights

  • Hybrid "Zero-Cost + Advanced AI" Model: Farmers with zero budget can use the built-in deterministic expert engine offline with zero API cost, while users needing deep reasoning can supply their own Gemini key seamlessly without locking the platform behind paywalls.
  • Active Scenario Stress-Testing: Unlike passive dashboards that only read static weather, AgriSmart features scenario simulation toggles (Frost at 1°C, Heatwave at 39°C, Wind at 34 km/h), allowing farmers to stress-test their operational schedule against potential extreme climate events.
  • Gamified Conservation Auditing: The platform does not just log data—it calculates an actionable delta between what the farmer applied versus the optimal baseline, presenting real-time "Water Conserved" metrics that visually reward sustainable behavior.
